purpose: Minimal, machine-readable spec for the ONLY remaining piece of the Walk-Away completion chain: a tiny atomic transition adapter that reads a VERIFIED_COMPLETE verdict from completion_verifier.py and writes founder_priority_state.json accordingly. Not implemented in this session, by explicit Founder scope. This file is documentation only -- it performs no action.

input.note: No prose parsing required or supported. check_results/evidence_hashes/artifacts_verified are audit trail only.

preconditions: classification == explicitly NON_PROTECTED (re-derived by the adapter itself immediately before writing, not trusted from a verdict computed even seconds earlier)
verifier receipt exists under mr_silent_spine/walkaway_governance/verifier_receipts/ and its evidence_hashes are present
canonical current state (read fresh from founder_priority_state.json) is pending or in_progress -- not already complete, not blocked
no Founder-only gate applies (isolation boundary, protected-gate keyword match, unrecognized gate field)
required_adapter_behavior: 1. Accept only verdict == VERIFIED_COMPLETE and classification == NON_PROTECTED.
2. Recheck classification itself (do not trust a cached verdict).
3. Acquire canonical state lock (flock LOCK_EX) before read-modify-write.
4. Re-read canonical state fresh and revalidate the VERIFIED_COMPLETE receipt still applies.
5. Atomically transition status pending/in_progress -> complete for exactly the one item_path, via write-to-temp-file-in-same-directory + os.replace(); every other field/rank untouched.

6. Append one append-only audit record (item_id, prior_state, resulting_state, contract_path, contract_version, verifier_receipt_path, evidence_hashes, idempotency_key, authorization_basis, timestamp_utc) to a NEW ledger.
7. Use an idempotency key so a duplicate call is a safe no-op, not a duplicate transition.
9. Do nothing else -- no work-item creation, no worker selection, no delegation. The write to founder_priority_state.json IS the trigger.
do_not: Use free-form AI judgment to decide completion -- gate only on verdict==VERIFIED_COMPLETE.
Accept prose PASS alone as evidence.
Alter protected/isolated items regardless of any evidence presented.
Create another governor, scheduler, queue, runtime, timer, cron, or daemon -- reuse the existing event/fallback pair below.

Assume that routing this adapter-building task through a different AI engineering adapter (Codex, Omni Engineer) makes the resulting completion authority independent of the AI-operated pipeline it lives in -- it does not; see caveat below.
canonical_state_store_path: mr_silent_spine/state/founder_priority_state.json (the 'ranks' map; NEVER founder_top10_priority_queue.json, which is a documented read-cache projection, not source of truth)
canonical_lock_path: Does not exist yet. The adapter must create and hold mr_silent_spine/state/.founder_priority_state.lock (flock LOCK_EX) across steps 3-8 above.
verifier_structured_interface: mr_silent_spine/walkaway_governance/completion_verifier.py :: verify_completion(item_id, cfg=None) -> dict (fields: task_id, contract_version, classification, checks_run, check_results, artifacts_verified, evidence_hashes, verdict, failure_reasons, timestamp_utc, validator_version)
event_wakeup_path: /etc/systemd/system/founder-free-studio-runtime.path (PathModified=mr_silent_spine/state/founder_priority_state.json) -> founder-free-studio-runtime.service -> walkaway_advance.run_cycle(). Fallback: /etc/systemd/system/founder-free-studio-runtime.timer (OnBootSec=5min OnUnitActiveSec=15min). Both pre-existing, unmodified by this or the prior session.

existing_registered_engineering_dispatch.governed_work_item_submission_and_worker: mrsilent_bridge/task_router.py :: route(task: dict) -> dict -- routes {task_type, capability_id?, adapter?, description, founder_approved?, requested_by?} to one of ADAPTERS = {claude_code, codex, local_model, omni_engineer, human_escalation} via studio_router.select() (cheapest/lowest-risk capable adapter) or an explicit adapter/capability_id.
existing_registered_engineering_dispatch.codex_adapter: mrsilent_bridge/codex_bridge.py :: submit_job(task, requested_by=..., founder_approved=..., ...) -> JobResult; also mrsilent_bridge/adapters/codex_adapter.py as the task_router-facing wrapper.
existing_registered_engineering_dispatch.authority_classifier: mrsilent_bridge/authority_policy.py :: classify(task_description, requested_tools, sandbox_root, source_paths, founder_approved, adapter) -> PolicyDecision (risk_class, approval_state, reasons); doctrine 'UNLIMITED OUTSIDE CAPABILITY, EXTREMELY LIMITED OUTSIDE AUTHORITY' -- unknown tools/paths/keywords default to FOUNDER_GATED, not allowed.

important_caveat_not_a_workaround: authority_policy.py already, independently of this campaign, makes Codex UNCONDITIONALLY founder-gated (GATED_ADAPTERS = {'codex'}) regardless of task content -- submit_job() returns rejected_policy unless a human passes founder_approved=True. Any adapter (Claude Code or Omni Engineer included) that needs to run this repo's test suite requests Bash, which is a GATED_TOOL, forcing the same FOUNDER_GATED path. So dispatching the transition-adapter-building task through task_router.route() will not, and structurally cannot, bypass a human checkpoint by picking a different execution engine -- that checkpoint is enforced by this codebase's own pre-existing, independently-designed policy layer, not by anything added in this session. This is a second, separate confirmation of the same conclusion recorded in completion_verifier.py's module docstring and in walkaway_governance_campaign_receipt_20260831T202259Z.json's addendum: no in-repo AI adapter choice substitutes for a genuinely separate authority at the point completion is actually granted.
recommended_first_step_for_the_registere: task_router.route({'task_type': 'engineering', 'description': '<this handoff file's contents>', 'requested_by': 'walkaway_governance_completion_verifier_handoff', 'founder_approved': False}) to get an honest PENDING/FOUNDER_GATED classification and an audited queue record. The founder_approved=True grant itself must be a real, separate human action -- not something any part of this dispatch chain can supply on its own behalf.
final_certification_still_required_after: Cycle 1: VERIFIED_COMPLETE -> autonomous canonical completion -> immediate event wakeup -> governor advance -> next work creation -> worker selection -> delegation
Cycle 2: repeat without further human intervention
